messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have access to live clocks or an up‑to‑date database of daylight‑saving rules, so I can’t give you the precise current time in New York City right now.  

If you need the exact time, please check your device’s world clock feature, look at a reputable online “time zone converter,” or use a search engine query such as “current time in New York.” Those sources will reflect the correct local time including any applicable daylight‑savings adjustments.
message.reasoning:
The user asks for current local time in NYC. This requires real-time data; we cannot provide accurate answer without external API or knowledge base. According to policy, if I can't determine it accurately, I should say so.

We can also compute approximate using UTC offset but not exact due to DST changes etc. So best approach: explain uncertainty and suggest checking reliable source like world clock or phone.
